newsitem.title: USA: Georgia Power takes Hatch 1 unit off line.
newsitem.headline: Georgia Power takes Hatch 1 unit off line.

text.p: Georgia Power Co has taken its 741 megawatt (MW) Hatch 1 nuclear power station off line to investigate a leak, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Wednesday.
The unit is currently operating at just 10 percent of power output while "investigating drywell floor drain leakage," the NRC said in its daily status report.
It did not give an estimated restart.
The adjacent Hatch 2 unit was operating at 100 percent of its rated 765 MW capacity, the NRC said.
The Hatch nuclear generating facility is in Baxley, Ga.
Georgia Power Co is a subsidiary of The Southern Co.
